# Cornell Legal Information Institute (LII)

> > Cornell's Legal Information Institute provides free, open access to authoritative U.S. legal materials including the Constitution, federal statutes, regulations, court decisions, and procedural rules.

The Legal Information Institute (LII) is a nonprofit organization at Cornell Law School dedicated to making U.S. law freely accessible to the public. LII maintains comprehensive databases of federal legal materials and state law resources, serving as a foundational open-access legal information platform.

## Core Legal References

- [U.S. Constitution](https://www.law.cornell.edu/constitution): Full text of U.S. Constitution with annotations and commentary
- [U.S. Code](https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text): Complete U.S. Code statutory database and index
- [Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (e-CFR)](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text): Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (e-CFR) full text database
- [Supreme Court Decisions](https://www.law.cornell.edu/supremecourt/text/home): Supreme Court case decisions and opinions archive
- [Uniform Commercial Code](https://www.law.cornell.edu/ucc): Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) full text and reference
- [Get the Law](https://www.law.cornell.edu/lii/get_the_law): Directory of legal collections including Constitution, U.S. Code, CFR

## Federal Rules & Procedures

- [Federal Rules of Civil Procedure](https://www.law.cornell.edu/rules/frcp): Federal Rules of Civil Procedure full text and reference
- [Federal Rules of Criminal Procedure](https://www.law.cornell.edu/rules/frcrmp): Federal Rules of Criminal Procedure full text and reference
- [Federal Rules of Appellate Procedure](https://www.law.cornell.edu/rules/frap): Federal Rules of Appellate Procedure reference and full text
- [Federal Rules of Evidence](https://www.law.cornell.edu/rules/fre): Federal Rules of Evidence full text and legal reference
- [Federal Rules of Bankruptcy Procedure](https://www.law.cornell.edu/rules/frbp): Federal Rules of Bankruptcy Procedure full text and reference

## State Laws & Resources

- [States](https://www.law.cornell.edu/states): Directory of state laws, statutes, constitutions, and regulations
